title: Amazon is replacing its Rufus AI shopping assistant with Alexa for Shopping, powered by Alexa+, on Amazon.com and its app for all customers in the US (Jennifer Pattison Tuohy/The Verge)
summary: Jennifer Pattison Tuohy / The Verge: Amazon is replacing its Rufus AI shopping assistant with Alexa for Shopping, powered by Alexa+, on Amazon.com and its app for all customers in the US — The company is giving its AI-powered assistant special shopping skills on its website and app. … Beginning today, when you type a query into Amazon …
